description: This file provides a utility support structure for microphone refresh and voice wake features in a macOS application, including observer setup, task scheduling, device name retrieval, and voice wake binding.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts an audio input device observer and triggers a refresh callback when an event occurs.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh action after a delay, canceling any previous scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the selected microphone device based on its identifier.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for voice wake state toggle, updating AppState accordingly.
